purpose: The Wallet Service manages digital wallets for customers, allowing them to track balances, top up funds from funding sources, and send money between wallets.

components.name: Mobile API Gateway
components.evidence: This is the front door. Every request from the mobile app goes through it first.

components.name: Keycloak
components.evidence: This is the identity provider (IdP). It knows our customers and it can say 'yes, this token is valid' or 'no, it is not'.

components.name: wallet-core
components.evidence: This is the brain. It contains the business rules: can this wallet send this amount, what happens if two transfers arrive at the same time, and so on.

components.name: wallet-db (PostgreSQL)
components.evidence: This is the memory. It stores balances, the list of transactions and the profile of the owner.

flows.evidence: The gateway asks Keycloak every time.
The gateway asks Keycloak every time.
The path of a request is: Mobile app, then gateway, then Keycloak for validation, then back to the gateway, then wallet-core, then wallet-db.
